descriptions.long: Abkhazia is a partially recognized state that broke from Georgia in 1993 and is recognized by Russia and a few other states. It occupies a coastal strip between the Black Sea and the Caucasus, Sukhumi is its capital, and the Russian ruble is used.
descriptions.short: Abkhazia is a partially recognized republic on the eastern Black Sea coast, claimed by Georgia.

flag.description: The flag of Afghanistan is composed of three equal vertical bands of black, red and green, with the national emblem in white centered in the red band.

descriptions.long: Afghanistan is a country bordering Pakistan, Iran, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and China, with Kabul as its capital. Pashto and Dari are the official languages, and farming employs most of the workforce across mountainous, arid terrain.
descriptions.short: Afghanistan is a landlocked country in South and Central Asia, crossed by the Hindu Kush range.

flag.description: The flag of Albania features a silhouetted double-headed black eagle at the center of a red field.

descriptions.long: Albania is a republic bordering Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia and Greece, with Tirana as its capital. Albanian is the official language, the lek is the currency, and services, agriculture and hydroelectric power form the base of the economy.
descriptions.short: Albania is a parliamentary republic in the western Balkans, on the Adriatic and Ionian seas.

flag.description: The flag of Algeria features two equal vertical bands of green and white. A five-pointed red star within a fly-side facing red crescent is centered over the two-color boundary.

descriptions.long: Algeria is a republic with Algiers as its capital and Arabic and Tamazight as official languages, with French widely used. The dinar is the currency, and natural gas and crude oil piped to Europe supply the majority of export earnings.
descriptions.short: Algeria is the largest country in Africa by area, on the Mediterranean with the Sahara to its south.

flag.description: The flag of American Samoa has a dark blue field, at the center of which is a red-edged white isosceles triangle that is based on the fly end and points towards the hoist side. Within this triangle is a brown and white bald eagle clutching a uatogi war club and a fue fly whisk.

descriptions.long: American Samoa is the only United States territory south of the equator, with Pago Pago as its seat of government. Residents are United States nationals, English and Samoan are the official languages, and tuna canning and public jobs lead the economy.
descriptions.short: American Samoa is an unincorporated United States territory made up of five islands and two atolls.

flag.description: The flag of Andorra features three equal vertical bands of blue, yellow and red, with the coat of arms of Andorra centered in the yellow band.

descriptions.long: Andorra is a co-principality of 468 square kilometres of mountain valleys, headed jointly by the president of France and the bishop of Urgell. Catalan is the official language, the euro is the currency, and tourism, retail and banking lead the economy.
descriptions.short: Andorra is a small landlocked principality in the eastern Pyrenees, bordered by France and Spain.

flag.description: The flag of Angola features two equal horizontal bands of red and black, with a yellow emblem at its centre. This emblem consists of a five-pointed star within the hoist-side facing half of a cogwheel that is crossed on its lower end by a machete.

descriptions.long: Angola is a republic that gained independence from Portugal in 1975, with Luanda as its capital and largest city. Portuguese is the official language, the kwanza is the currency, and petroleum and diamonds supply most export earnings.
descriptions.short: Angola is a republic on the Atlantic coast of southern Africa, bordering Namibia and Zambia.

flag.description: The flag of Anguilla has a dark blue field. It features the flag of the United Kingdom — the Union Jack — in the canton and a white shield bearing three interlocking orange dolphins above a light blue base, centered in the fly half.

descriptions.long: Anguilla is a self-governing British overseas territory with The Valley as its capital and a governor appointed by the Crown. English is the official language, the East Caribbean dollar is the currency, and tourism and finance lead the economy.
descriptions.short: Anguilla is a British overseas territory at the northern end of the eastern Caribbean chain.

flag.description: The flag of Antarctica has a light blue field, at the center of which is a white silhouette of the continent of Antarctica.

descriptions.long: Antarctica is a continent with no permanent population and no government of its own. The Antarctic Treaty, in force since 1961, reserves it for peaceful scientific use and holds territorial claims in abeyance among the states with stations there.
descriptions.short: Antarctica is the southernmost continent, governed by treaty rather than by any single state.

descriptions.long: Indonesia is the largest archipelagic state and among the most populous countries, with Jakarta as its capital and Indonesian as its official language. The rupiah is the currency, and coal, palm oil, nickel and gas lead its exports.
descriptions.short: Indonesia is a Southeast Asian archipelago republic of more than 17,000 islands on the equator.
